title: secrets.manifest.json
description: Declares an app's secrets: metadata only, never values. Editors use this schema; `secrets check` enforces the same rules with jq, plus the naming rules that need the repo and environment together.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest format, independent of the common release.

repo.description: Short repository name used in every cloud resource name, 3 to 11 characters.

projects.description: GCP project per environment. Defaults to <repo>-<env>. Required for rename-repo, because a rename keeps the project.

rollbackWindowDays.description: Days a superseded version stays enabled and, once disabled, before it is destroyed.

owner.description: Owning team, used as the owner label.

readers.description: Kinds whose <repo>-<kind>-<env> service accounts may read the value.

local.description: dev-env may fetch the value from the dev environment.

probe.description: Executable, relative to the manifest, that reads the value on stdin and exits 0 when the vendor accepts it.

generated.description: Terraform generates the value: a random alphanumeric string of 2 x bytes characters.

ci.description: A value a vendor forces into CI with no OIDC alternative. Requires ciReason.
